guide_page.title: User Guide
guide_page.subtitle: What this app does and a recommended workflow.
guide_page.quick_start_body:
1. Run GUI启动器.bat, click Launch in the GUI — the browser opens automatically.
2. Open Settings, pick a vendor, enter API key, save.
3. Open Chat, choose a model, click New Chat.
guide_page.worlds_body: Create worlds, characters, and lore on the Worlds page. Import/export .nworld.zip packs. World background images appear on the bookshelf.
guide_page.modes_body: Daily chat, world chat, roleplay (single character), and group chat (multi-character with @mentions).
guide_page.prompt_body: Session sidebar: prompt layers, lore budget, memories, display scripts. Enable extensions under Settings.
guide_page.appearance_body: Session backgrounds and immersive RP. Settings supports Edge/OpenAI/browser TTS with auto-play and per-character voices.
guide_page.tts_body: Enable TTS and auto-play in Settings. Backends: Edge (recommended), OpenAI-compatible API (official or proxy, POST /audio/speech), custom HTTP (AllTalk/XTTS etc. with {{text}}/{{voice}}/{{rate}} placeholders), or browser speech. Assign per-character voices on the world page; Tavern extensions.tts_voice imports automatically. Example proxy Base URL: https://your-proxy.com/v1. AllTalk custom HTTP: URL http://127.0.0.1:7851/api/tts-generate, body {"text":"{{text}}","voice":"{{voice}}"}.
guide_page.mods_body: Place MODs under data/mods/{id}/ with mod.json and entry files. Python MODs implement register(hooks) and may call hooks.register_hook and hooks.register_command. Frontend MODs declare assets in mod.json and use window.NovelWorldMods.registerHook. Requirements: mod_api_version ≤ 1 and min_app_version compatible with the app. Install .zip packages from Settings or the launcher.
guide_page.st_migration_body: Character cards: import Tavern V2/V3 JSON/PNG; character_book syncs to Lore. World Info: import/export Tavern entries on the Lore tab. Macros: {{char}}, {{user}}, {{persona}}, {{lore}}, {{time}}, etc. Presets: import Preset JSON with generation, prompt layers, and prompt_order. Greetings: alternate_greetings on the RP page.
guide_page.st_b_body: V3 cards, advanced Lore, session Lore, global Regex, prompt_order.
guide_page.st_c_body: Vector Lore, Data Bank, STscript, Chub/Risu import, ST Extension API shim, backend TTS and SD WebUI. Message edit supports fork branch. Configure embedding provider in Settings.
guide_page.faq_body: Stop service from Settings. If model list fetch fails, type the model name manually. MOD toggles apply on the next request.
